title: Fun activity to do in Sitges with friends
text: Meecedes has a nice shop with authentic Flamenco style clothing and accessories. We made a cute bag with leftover fabric. Very nice activity and Mercedes is very nice
author: Rob V

title: Beautiful bags and lasting memories
text:
It was a great experience. The people who weren’t very good at sewing were able to use the glue gun, and those of us who knew how to sew did. We all had an amazing time and created beautiful bags. There are templates you’re able to follow if you aren’t sure what design to do, or you can go wild and do whatever feels right! There was a large variety of fabrics with different colours, patterns and textures which really allowed for each bag to be unique even when using the same template. 

This activity isn’t a sewing lesson, but is accessible to all skill levels. The host was lovely and very pas
author: mheaw2025

title: Creativity with flamenco flair - express yourself with Mercedes and create a design you will be proud to take home!
text:
We had a wonderful time expressing ourselves with Mercedes' glorious fabrics and light touch guidance. It was clear she wanted each of us to create our own design but she gave help and advice whenever we asked.

We were a mixed group - teens, young adults, parents and a grandmother but she assured us we were all flamenca! Mercedes was patient well after our hour was up and each of us was pleased with what we made.

If you want a low key creative activity just outside of Barcelona (Sitges is just 30-40 mins and on a direct train) I can't recommend this highly enough.
author: EmAlJoeCaityElli

title: Fantastic and fun!
text: Mercedes was wonderful and created a welcoming atmosphere. The bag I created is beautiful and inspired by Mercedes’ passion for designing and flamenco.
author: Christine_T
